secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL (https://<project>.supabase.co). Optional — app boots with placeholder; needed for auth, bookmarks, prayer, history.

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase anon/public key (browser-safe). Optional at boot; needed for auth and user-scoped data.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service role key (server-only, bypasses RLS). Optional; needed for server-side DB writes (answers, graph, moderation).

secrets.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Google Gemini API key for the Bible study companion. Optional; route returns offline fallback when unset.

secrets.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
secrets.description: OpenAI API key for RAG embeddings (text-embedding-3-small). Optional; RAG features degrade without it.

secrets.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
secrets.description: Anthropic Claude API key for AI answer pipeline. Optional; AI answers degrade without it.
